note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 28 November 2026, RealHunt lists 32 homes for sale in Poland, each one checked by a person.
In Poland, the median asking price of those 32 homes is €75,170 (€1,139 per m², from the 32 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €49,707 and the most expensive €90,600.
Taxes and fees add about 2.5–4% to the price of a home in Poland (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Tax on civil law transactions (PCC) 2% of the value, paid by the buyer within 14 days of the deed; notary fee (taksa notarialna) capped at PLN 1,010 plus 0.4% of the value above PLN 60,000, plus 23% VAT; court fee of PLN 200 to enter ownership in the land register (plus PLN 100 for a new register); optional lawyer about 1%; the agent fee (about 2-3%) depends on the agreement.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: EU, EEA and Swiss citizens buy on the same terms as Poles. Other foreigners can buy an apartment without a permit, but usually need a permit from the Ministry of the Interior (MSWiA) to buy a house or land.
buying.annual_property_tax: Owners pay a local property tax (podatek od nieruchomości) set by the commune, capped in 2026 at PLN 1.25 per m² of usable floor space for flats and houses.
buying.rental_income_tax: Private rental income is taxed as a flat lump sum (ryczałt) of 8.5% of revenue up to PLN 100,000 a year and 12.5% above that.

At about €448/m² it is roughly 59% below the median asking price for flats in Bytom (4,783 zł/m², Morizon sample, October 2026).

The ground floor has a living room, separate kitchen and WC, and the first floor has two bedrooms with balconies and a bathroom with bath and shower. Outdoor and extra features include a garden of about 161 m², a fireplace in the living room, two courtyard parking spaces and CCTV. The home has gas heating and a new Viessmann boiler fitted two years ago, and it is a 5-minute walk from Rumia Janowo SKM station. Asking €49,707, about €497/m².
